notes.title: Arcane Board is out!
notes.content:
Collect magical tiles and deploy them strategically on your Arcane Board in this block sudoku and roguelike deckbuilder. Set up combos and unleash them at the right time—whether offensively, defensively, or to build your power. Master and learn the secrets of the board. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/27023349/a85d9ac7824fb7e9c5766847843e8f1e2fc7dacf.gif[/img]

Get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126090/Arcane_Board/

To celebrate, we are also setting our other games for discount. Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Druidwalker Gamepad Update and Nintendo Switch Release!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Druidwalker is getting improved gamepad support: the controls should be smoother starting from today. You can play the game with gamepad only.

When we started working on gamepad controls, it only made sense to port the game on Nintendo Switch.
You can get it here: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/druidwalker-switch/

Thanks for playing and have a good weekend ahead!
Best,
Vladimir

notes.title: Druidwalker 1.1 - Gamepad Support / Achievements
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support and your kind reviews!

After reviewing your feedback, we've implemented achievements and gamepad control support.
Let us know if anything else comes up!
Best,
Vladimir and Druidwalker Team

notes.title: Druidwalker Artbook is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Players! Thank you for your support with Druidwalker and warm reception of the game. Triin Aare, an amazing Estonian artist, has worked very hard to make art for the game. 

The Druidwalker was not born in one day: over the course of time, we've been meeting for the drawing sessions in cafes and public plcaes. Once I got to know the art of Triin a bit more, I've been impressed by her vision of the world and ability to bring her imagination to life. For a long time, she wanted to make art for books, and while this _technically_ isn't a book, I sincerely hope that working on Druidwalker brings her dream closer.

In case you want to support us, you can get it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478740/Druidwalker__Artbook/

Again, thank you so much for your support and feedback. 
Best wishes,
Vladimir

notes.title: Druidwalker is out NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Druidwalker is out on Steam NOW![/b] It is the next peaceful game produced and published by Coldwild Games!

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231060/Druidwalker/ 

Step into the role of a druid preparing the forest for winter. Delve into the heart of the mystical forest, explore its paths, and experience the beauty of nature. Druidwalker provides a peaceful roguelike adventure, where challenges offer opportunities for growth and reflection. Rest at the bonfire, rejuvenate, and continue your journey with renewed vigor. The game features traditional instrumental music, creating a peaceful and immersive experience.

Watch the trailer here: youtu.be/-7Ho_vyXo80
It's a short experience, but a lot of love went into creating this one, so I hope you'll decide to give it a try! :) The game has been created by a multinational team of developers located in Latvia and published by Coldwild Games.

Hope you have a great week ahead, 
Elizabete from Coldwild Games

notes.title: The NEW launch trailer is out and EXCITING news!
notes.content:
Druidwalker, the next peaceful game developed by talent current living in Latvia and produced by Coldwild Games, is out on Steam tomorrow. 

Check out the new launch trailer: [previewyoutube=-7Ho_vyXo80;full][/previewyoutube]

In Druidwalker, players take on the role of a powerful druid preparing the forest for the approaching winter. As players explore the beautiful, hand-drawn landscapes, they will encounter a variety of animals and move at their own pace, without the pressure of time. The game features traditional instrumental music, creating a peaceful and immersive experience.

Coldwild Games is excited to offer players a new way to experience the world of roguelike games, with a peaceful and immersive journey through the forest. It's a short experience, but a lot of love went into creating this one, so I hope you'll decide to give it a try once it's out! :)


Have a chill rest of the week,
Elizabete from Coldwild Games
